tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Primary canvas — the warm paper background behind every screen. Never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary surface set slightly apart from the paper canvas: modal backgrounds, quote/code blocks, table zebra rows, the search-results panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-soft — headlines, body copy, primary UI labels. 17.2:1 on surface, 16.1:1 on surface-soft.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and surface-soft — metadata, captions, timestamps, helper text, placeholders. 6.1:1 / 5.7:1 — do not set below 14px.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline for rules, dividers, table lines and the resting outline of inputs, tags and cards. Structural only — it holds 1.4:1 against surface, so no interactive state (focus, selected, invalid, hover) relies on this color alone; those escalate to brand or accent.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary interactive color and the system's identity color — links, primary buttons, selected states, active navigation, focus rings, diagrams, the first data series. 11.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for brand-colored buttons, links and controls. 13.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Light tint behind a selected row, active nav item or hovered brand icon. brand reads 9.7:1 and ink 14.5:1 on this fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons set on a solid brand fill — primary button labels. 11.5:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Annotation color, used sparingly — margin markers, the active-annotation indicator, small reference badges, the finding symbol. 4.6:1 on surface, safe down to 14px; never a section background or a second brand color.

tokens.name: accent-surface
tokens.usage: Light tint behind a flagged reference or open annotation. Set text inside it in ink (14.6:1) rather than accent, which reads only 3.9:1 here — enough for icons and 18px+ type, not small body copy.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill — the rare filled finding badge. 4.6:1.

families.serif: "EB Garamond", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The single largest statement on a view — a cover line, an editorial splash. At most once per screen.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section headings; titles of major research objects (a source, a collection).

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Selected large quotations and pulled excerpts.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, abstracts, the opening line of a note.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy — notes, descriptions, empty-state text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary copy, dense lists, table cells, helper text under an input.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Navigation items, form labels, tab labels, filter names.

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Source metadata, index numbers, timestamps — set uppercase in CSS, tracked wide (SOURCE 024, AUTHOR / YEAR).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside a tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Space between a label and its value; gap between inline tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact controls — inputs, tags, filter chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card or source object; gap between stacked metadata lines.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between a heading and the copy beneath it; gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between unrelated blocks within one column.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between major sections; the annotation margin's default width increment.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop; space above a section introduction.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space around a cover statement or a full-bleed section break.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Research objects, index rows and tables that sit directly on the page without a container.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, source objects — the system's default. Do not exceed this without reason.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Reserved for a genuine pill control (a toggle switch, a status dot) and for the canvas-register badge pill — never a button.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Elevation for a modal or popover only — the single shadow this system uses. Cards and buttons stay flat, told apart by border and surface instead.
